open_items: Live non-project closure, computed-status services and CLI/rendering adapters remain assigned to their actual providers and later steps. These are partial behavior tests, not full-suite or release evidence.

oracle.requirement_contract: Ohne expliziten letzten Sortierschlüssel MUSS die Artefakt-ID als deterministischer Tie-Breaker dienen.
oracle.scope: 11.l.W adds same-snapshot ViewData configuration selection, inherited parent/hash binding, exact original inputs, deterministic NFC/ID sorting and bounded graph traversal through applicable nodes only. No CLI/rendering completion or full-suite/release claim. 11.l.R adds explicit missing preservation and bounded nested record data in the same configured snapshot.

preconditions: 11.l.W: complete owned snapshot with native view/configuration records; no live discovery, rendering or approval provider.
steps: 11.l.W: select actual configured rows and eligible graph nodes through the same native Query service, compare stable ID ties and explicit ID ordering, and bind selected scope/configuration plus original bytes. Preserve all potential variants when no selection is supplied.

11.l.R: preserve missing cells explicitly without null/type coercion; evaluate acyclic nested records projections with independent native graph bounds, stable target IDs and original source bindings; reject malformed/unused definitions before filtering.
11.l.C: extract unchanged native scope/configuration/query selection and typed row evaluation into private services; preserve all W/R tests, public bindings, grouping, error contracts and effects.
